context.en-US: The Val158Met polymorphism stratifies COMT activity and fisetin response in an inverted-U pattern in Met/Met carriers. Genotype gates catecholamine turnover and worrier-type symptoms.
context.zh-TW: Val158Met 多型性以倒 U 模式分層 COMT 活性與 fisetin 反應。基因型門控兒茶酚胺周轉與憂慮者型症狀。

context.en-US: Exercise-generated ROS bursts drive PGC-1alpha-dependent mitochondrial biogenesis (Ristow reviews). ASCII spelling matches existing triples; post-workout antioxidants blunt this signal.
context.zh-TW: 運動產生的 ROS 爆發驅動 PGC-1alpha 依賴的粒線體生成（Ristow 回顧）。ASCII 拼寫沿用既有 triple；運動後抗氧化劑減弱此訊號。

context.en-US: Exercise induces endogenous SOD/GPx via NRF2; antioxidant supplementation blocks this adaptation (Ristow 2009). NRF2 spelling matches the existing sulfiredoxin triple.
context.zh-TW: 運動經由 NRF2 誘發內生 SOD/GPx；抗氧化補充阻斷此適應（Ristow 2009）。NRF2 拼寫沿用既有的 sulfiredoxin triple。

context.en-US: PGC-1alpha is the master regulator of mitochondrial biogenesis downstream of exercise, fasting and cold stress. Textbook-level causation.
context.zh-TW: PGC-1alpha 是運動、禁食與冷壓力下游粒線體生成的主調節因子。教科書等級因果。

context.en-US: CRISPR/shRNA screens identify karyopherin-beta-1 as an ivermectin target in ovarian cancer (Kodama 2017), blocking cell cycle with paclitaxel synergy. Importin blockade is distinct from PAK1 degradation.
context.zh-TW: CRISPR/shRNA 篩選確認 karyopherin-beta-1 為 ivermectin 在卵巢癌的標的（Kodama 2017），阻斷細胞週期並與 paclitaxel 協同。Importin 阻斷不同於 PAK1 降解。

context.en-US: Ivermectin inhibits HSP27 phosphorylation (Nappi 2020), enhancing anti-EGFR activity. Chaperone modulation adds a proteostasis arm to its anticancer out-star.
context.zh-TW: Ivermectin 抑制 HSP27 磷酸化（Nappi 2020），增強抗 EGFR 活性。伴侶調節為其抗癌出向之星增添蛋白穩態臂。

context.en-US: PAK1 degradation suppresses downstream Akt signaling toward autophagy and apoptosis. Well-replicated arm of the ivermectin out-star, distinct from direct kinase inhibition.
context.zh-TW: PAK1 降解抑制下游 Akt 訊號朝向自噬與凋亡。ivermectin 出向之星中充分複製的臂，不同於直接激酶抑制。

context.en-US: Ivermectin is the semi-synthetic dihydro derivative of avermectin from Streptomyces avermitilis (Nobel 2015 history). Definitional chemistry fact.
context.zh-TW: Ivermectin 是源自 Streptomyces avermitilis 的 avermectin 半合成二氫衍生物（Nobel 2015 歷史）。定義性化學事實。

context.en-US: Ivermectin directly depolarizes mitochondrial membranes, raising Bax, lowering Bcl-2 and releasing cytochrome c. Distinct from fenbendazole's HK2-VDAC detachment route.
context.zh-TW: Ivermectin 直接去極化粒線體膜，升高 Bax、降低 Bcl-2 並釋放 cytochrome c。不同於 fenbendazole 的 HK2-VDAC 脫離路徑。

context.en-US: Hexokinase 2 anchors to VDAC to block apoptosome assembly, the canonical anti-apoptotic tether that fenbendazole detaches. Central metabolic-apoptotic junction.
context.zh-TW: Hexokinase 2 錨定 VDAC 以阻斷 apoptosome 組裝，即 fenbendazole 脫離的典型抗凋亡繫留。核心代謝—凋亡交界。

context.en-US: Ivermectin inhibits P-gp plus MRP1/2/3 efflux pumps (Didier & Loor 1996), reversing multidrug resistance broadly. Superset of the existing P-gp-only edge.
context.zh-TW: Ivermectin 抑制 P-gp 及 MRP1/2/3 外排泵（Didier & Loor 1996），廣泛逆轉多重抗藥性。是既有 P-gp 邊的超集。

context.en-US: p53 culls transduced reprogramming-competent cells via p21, apoptosis and senescence, the dominant upstream barrier to iPSC induction. Fenbendazole stabilization of p53 directly opposes rejuvenation.
context.zh-TW: p53 經由 p21、凋亡與衰老淘汰被轉導的重編程能力細胞，是 iPSC 誘發的主要上游屏障。Fenbendazole 穩定 p53 直接對抗回春。

context.en-US: SIRT6 inhibits JAK2/STAT3 inflammatory signaling, a sirtuin counter-regulation node converging on the same inflammaging axis metformin targets. Slash object normalizes to one node.
context.zh-TW: SIRT6 抑制 JAK2/STAT3 發炎訊號，是匯聚於 metformin 標靶的相同發炎老化軸的 sirtuin 反調節節點。斜線物件正規化為單一節點。

context.en-US: SARM1 NADase activity executes Wallerian axon degeneration and is a druggable ALS node. NAD+ depletion links SARM1 to the sirtuin-starvation corridor.
context.zh-TW: SARM1 NADase 活性執行 Wallerian 軸突退化，是可藥物化的 ALS 節點。NAD+ 耗竭將 SARM1 連結到 sirtuin 飢餓走廊。

context.en-US: C9orf72 haploinsufficiency plus RNA-foci/DPR toxicity disrupts autophagy and proteostasis in ALS/FTD. The tidy loop ties repeat expansion to clearance failure.
context.zh-TW: C9orf72 單倍劑量不足及 RNA-foci/DPR 毒性在 ALS/FTD 破壞自噬與蛋白穩態。此整齊迴圈將重複擴增與清除失敗連結。

context.en-US: TDP-43-driven mitochondrial rupture releases mtDNA that engages cGAS-STING interferon signaling. This organizes the tau/TDP-43/FTD disease community around innate immunity.
context.zh-TW: TDP-43 驅動的粒線體破裂釋放接合 cGAS-STING 干擾素訊號的 mtDNA。此圍繞先天免疫組織 tau/TDP-43/FTD 疾病群落。

context.en-US: Dopamine autoxidizes via iron/MAO routes to quinones plus 6-OHDA, forming alpha-synuclein adducts. This catecholamine-oxidation chemistry bridges dopamine handling to Parkinson pathology.
context.zh-TW: Dopamine 經由鐵/MAO 路徑自氧化為 quinones 及 6-OHDA，形成 alpha-synuclein 加合物。此兒茶酚胺氧化化學將多巴胺處理連結到帕金森病理。

context.en-US: Microglial nitric oxide plus superoxide forms peroxynitrite that tyrosine-nitrates alpha-synuclein into Lewy-body aggregates. ASCII spelling avoids a node split with the DJ-1 chaperone edge.
context.zh-TW: 微膠細胞 nitric oxide 加超氧形成 peroxynitrite，酪氨酸硝化 alpha-synuclein 為 Lewy 體聚集。ASCII 拼寫避免與 DJ-1 伴侶邊的節點分裂。

context.en-US: Glucocerebrosidase activation (ambroxol chaperone, ASPro-PD Phase 3) clears alpha-synuclein lysosomally. Lysosomal clearance is the therapeutic lever in GBA-Parkinson disease.
context.zh-TW: Glucocerebrosidase 活化（ambroxol 伴侶，ASPro-PD 三期）經溶酶體清除 alpha-synuclein。溶酶體清除是 GBA-帕金森的治療槓桿。

context.en-US: Fasting-driven AMPK activates TFEB for lysosomal biogenesis and autophagy, overlapping UPRmt/mitophagy programs. Distinct subject from the existing Intermittent Fasting edges.
context.zh-TW: 禁食驅動的 AMPK 活化 TFEB 以進行溶酶體生成與自噬，與 UPRmt/mitophagy 程序重疊。主詞不同於既有的 Intermittent Fasting 邊。

context.en-US: Controlled heat stress induces HSP70/90 chaperones for proteostasis, with Finnish sauna cohort CVD/dementia benefit. XenohormesisESIS-grade evidence for thermal hormesis.
context.zh-TW: 受控熱壓力誘發 HSP70/90 伴侶以維持蛋白穩態，芬蘭桑拿隊列具 CVD/失智益處。熱荷爾蒙的 xenohormesis 級證據。

context.en-US: Controlled intermittent mild hypoxia stabilizes HIF-1alpha driving EPO, antioxidant and BDNF programs (Li 2024). ASCII spelling matches the existing induces-HIF-1alpha edge.
context.zh-TW: 受控間歇輕度缺氧穩定 HIF-1alpha，驅動 EPO、抗氧化與 BDNF 程序（Li 2024）。ASCII 拼寫沿用既有的 induces-HIF-1alpha 邊。

context.en-US: Exercise-induced muscle damage signals via TNF-alpha/IL-6 to proliferate satellite cells; NSAIDs block the adaptation (Mikkelsen 2009). Acute inflammatory signaling as repair trigger.
context.zh-TW: 運動誘發的肌肉損傷經由 TNF-alpha/IL-6 訊號增生衛星細胞；NSAID 阻斷此適應（Mikkelsen 2009）。急性發炎訊號作為修復觸發。

context.en-US: Neutrophil myeloperoxidase plus ROS oxidizes local epinephrine to adrenochrome. Stronger mechanistic edge than the existing low-confidence Neutrophils-oxidize parent (0.5).
context.zh-TW: 嗜中性球 myeloperoxidase 加 ROS 將局部 epinephrine 氧化為 adrenochrome。比既有低信度 Neutrophils 氧化母邊（0.5）更強的機制邊。

context.en-US: Inflammaging upregulates CD38 on neutrophils and macrophages, starving sirtuins of NAD+. Cellular-resolution leg of the established CD38-consumes-NAD+ triple.
context.zh-TW: 發炎老化在嗜中性球與巨噬細胞上調 CD38，使 sirtuins 缺乏 NAD+。已確立的 CD38 消耗 NAD+ triple 的細胞解析度分支。

context.en-US: NMN restores NAD+ co-substrate availability for sirtuins, distinct from allosteric STAC activation. Standard precursor biology paired with the existing NR-sirtuin edge.
context.zh-TW: NMN 恢復 sirtuins 的 NAD+ 輔受質可及性，不同於別構 STAC 活化。標準前驅物生物學，與既有的 NR-sirtuin 邊配對。

context.en-US: Honokiol activates SIRT3 to increase ATP and reduce ROS/lipid peroxidation in kidney injury models. Supported pharmacology, kept at moderate confidence per file hypothesis framing.
context.zh-TW: Honokiol 活化 SIRT3，在腎損傷模型增加 ATP 並減少 ROS/脂質過氧化。藥理支持，依檔案假設框架維持中等信度。

context.en-US: Severe COVID-19 drives CD38-NADase-mediated NAD+ depletion (Heer 2020), feeding sirtuin loss and inflammaging. Systemic-viral arm of the NAD+ corridor.
context.zh-TW: 重症 COVID-19 驅動 CD38-NADase 介導的 NAD+ 耗竭（Heer 2020），供養 sirtuin 缺失與發炎老化。NAD+ 走廊的全身病毒臂。

context.en-US: Metformin activates AMPK as first-line nutrient-sensing pharmacology, suppressing SASP in the same longevity space as rapamycin. Canonical mechanism, new subject for the tasks layer.
context.zh-TW: Metformin 活化 AMPK 作為一線營養感測藥理，在與 rapamycin 相同的長壽空間抑制 SASP。典型機制，tasks 層的新主詞。

context.en-US: DJ-1 detoxifies glyoxal to glycolic acid GSH-independently, parallel to methylglyoxal-to-L-lactate conversion. Second substrate leg of the DJ-1 glyoxalase program.
context.zh-TW: DJ-1 不依賴 GSH 將 glyoxal 解毒為 glycolic acid，與 methylglyoxal 到 L-lactate 轉換平行。DJ-1 乙二醛酶程序的第二受質分支。

context.en-US: DJ-1 blocks KEAP1 to stabilize Nrf2, the mechanistic basis of the existing DJ-1-Nrf2 edge. Upstream cause recorded as its own triple.
context.zh-TW: DJ-1 阻斷 KEAP1 以穩定 Nrf2，是既有 DJ-1-Nrf2 邊的機制基礎。上游原因記錄為獨立 triple。

context.en-US: DJ-1 modulates DRP1-dependent fission in neuroprotection models. Single-path evidence, kept at low-moderate confidence with the file's own caution.
context.zh-TW: DJ-1 在神經保護模型調節 DRP1 依賴的分裂。單一路徑證據，依檔案自身的警語維持中低信度。

context.en-US: DJ-1 binds alpha-synuclein intermediates to prevent fibrillization. ASCII spelling consolidated with the peroxynitrite edge to avoid a node split.
context.zh-TW: DJ-1 結合 alpha-synuclein 中間體以防止纖維化。ASCII 拼寫與 peroxynitrite 邊合併以免節點分裂。

context.en-US: Adrenochrome redox cycling consumes glutathione, disabling GLO1/GLO2 dicarbonyl clearance. This couples catecholamine oxidation to glycation defense collapse.
context.zh-TW: Adrenochrome 氧化還原循環消耗 glutathione，使 GLO1/GLO2 二羰基清除失效。此將兒茶酚胺氧化耦合到糖化防禦崩潰。

context.en-US: Sirtuins broadly brake apoptotic execution at the degree-392 hub survival side, complementing the SASP-suppression arm. Family-level summary edge.
context.zh-TW: Sirtuins 在 degree-392 樞紐的存活側廣泛煞停凋亡執行，補充 SASP 抑制臂。家族層級總結邊。

context.en-US: CD38 inhibitor 78c preserves and raises NAD+ with male-biased lifespan effects (Peclat 2022). Pharmacological counterpart to the CD38-consumes-NAD+ disease edge.
context.zh-TW: CD38 inhibitor 78c 保存並提高 NAD+，具雄性偏向的壽命效應（Peclat 2022）。CD38 消耗 NAD+ 疾病邊的藥理對應。

context.en-US: Estradiol prevents injury-induced Bcl-2 downregulation (Dubal 1999 OVX model). The one well-supported sex-dimorphic edge; other hormone claims were rejected as under-evidenced.
context.zh-TW: Estradiol 防止損傷誘發的 Bcl-2 下調（Dubal 1999 OVX 模型）。唯一充分支持的性別二態邊；其他荷爾蒙主張因證據不足被拒。

context.en-US: DRP1-mediated fission severs damaged segments for engulfment but cardiac DRP1-KO shows mitophagy persists without it. Softened from is_required_for per the file's own contradiction.
context.zh-TW: DRP1 介導的分裂切斷受損片段以供包吞，但心臟 DRP1-KO 顯示無它 mitophagy 仍持續。依檔案自身的矛盾從 is_required_for 放軟。

context.en-US: Only mitochondria-targeted catalase (mCAT) extends median lifespan ~20% (Schriner 2005); cytosolic catalase is null (Perez 2009). Qualified subject replaces the overstated generic edge.
context.zh-TW: 僅粒線體標靶 catalase（mCAT）延長中位壽命約 20%（Schriner 2005）；胞質 catalase 無效（Perez 2009）。限定主詞取代誇大的通用邊。
